paragraphs.text: Marrow-Gnawer united three nezumi gangs when he slew their leaders in a single night. Now they call him their first lord.
"Rats, rats, rats! Hundreds, thousands, millions of them, and every one a life." —Bram Stoker, *Dracula*
The Eastern Paladin doesn't attack at night for the tactical advantage. He does it for the sheer joy of fighting beneath the moon.
"East and West meet and angels cry. Unholy power darkens the sky." —"The Ballad of the Paladins"
"The mortal world is a grove of sweet fruit, and I am ready to harvest it." —Fallen angel
Beware anything born among the dead. —Tolarian saying
"These nezumi, they disgust me. The things they will do for money no other thinking creature would consider. This, of course, makes them useful beyond words." —Meloku the Clouded Mirror
"Just what I need—more competition." —Cabal grave robber
Four generations ago, old Split-Tail stole a bundle of scrolls from the Minamo School. Soon after, the first nezumi shamans were born.
The best ideas often come from the worst minds.
Bottom feeders sometimes rise to the top.
